keys.ui.hub.agents.hub_title: Agent Hub is the product surface name, kept English by glossary §1 and by the es copy everywhere else ('Volver al Agent Hub').
keys.ui.hub.teams.pull: pull is in the glossary's kept-English set for git/hub operations; the es guides elsewhere render it as 'Pull ahora'.
keys.ui.hub.teams.slot_with_count: Language-neutral: {role} plus a multiplication sign and {count}; no words to translate.
keys.ui.hub.teams.version: Language-neutral: the version prefix 'v' plus {version}; no words to translate.

terms_chosen.manager: gestor (agent that leads the chat; 'agente gestor', 'Gestor:')
terms_chosen.listing: ficha (a published catalogue entry: 'Actualizar la ficha existente', 'Abrir la ficha')
terms_chosen.brief: resumen ('Resumen del proyecto', 'Resumen de colaboración') - 'brief' has no settled Spanish product term and a calque was avoided
terms_chosen.starter: agente incluido ('Instalado desde un agente incluido')
terms_chosen.delist: retirar del hub ('Retirar agente', 'Agente retirado del hub')
terms_chosen.configuration run: ejecución de configuración (matches the existing audited es copy in the team conflict description)
terms_chosen.rule_fragments: the {label}{rule}. keys gained a colon ('Categorías: {rule}.') and the shared rule_* strings became impersonal ('no se admiten…') because Spanish participles cannot agree with every label's gender and number; the composed sentence stays grammatical for Nombre, Descripción, El cuerpo de instrucciones, Herramientas, Categorías, Etiquetas and Cuándo usarlo
terms_chosen.quotes: typographic quotes are the es “ ” pair in prose; straight quotes survive only where the string delimits literal characters ('/', '\', ':', '-', '.')

overflow_risks.note: No maxCells budget exists in this batch's context sidecars; these are width judgements, not gate failures.
flags: ui.agents.detail.on / off: 'Activado' / 'Desactivado' are 8 and 11 cells against 'On' / 'Off' (2 and 3). No shorter correct pair exists; 'Sí/No' would misdescribe a mode.

ui.agents.page.scope_custom / scope_builtin / scope_installed: 'Personalizados', 'Integrados', 'Instalados' in a filter chip row where English uses 'Custom', 'Built-in', 'Installed'. 'Propios' would be shorter but breaks the glossary's 'integrado' family.
ui.agents.detail.tool_name: 'Nombre de la herramienta' (24) for a 9-cell field label; the field row wraps.

ui.hub.agents.favourite / unfavourite: 'Añadir a favoritos' / 'Quitar de favoritos' (19/20) against 'Favourite agent' / 'Unfavourite agent' (15/18) - kept short deliberately; longer phrasings were avoided.
